title: Independent Voters Ready to Vote GOP Out, Says Wendy Davis
title_cn: 温迪·戴维斯表示，独立选民准备投票让共和党下台
summary: Former Texas State Senator Wendy Davis said that polling shows that independent voters are 'ready to vote the GOP out' in Texas. Davis, a Democrat, said that in order for her party to win a Senate seat in Texas, candidate James Talarico needs to keep offering solutions and stay disciplined on messaging. (Source: Bloomberg)
